profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Red Ventures
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with exceptional problem-solving skills and a growing passion for AI technologies. I have recently contributed to the development of an AI-powered chatbot utilizing GPT, where I designed and implemented intelligent solutions to enhance user interaction and data processing.

I’m highly interested in expanding my career within the AI domain, building intelligent systems, and leveraging machine learning to solve real-world problems. I am committed to continuous learning and contributing to innovative projects in the AI landscape.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
PlateaPR
•	Led the redesign of a multi-block WordPress website and successfully migrated it to WP Engine for improved performance and reliability.
•	Worked on an AI-driven search tool copilot, delivering an innovative solution for enhanced user interactions.
•	Led a team of two engineers and co-led a group of contractors, ensuring smooth project execution and collaboration.
•	Technologies used: WordPress, WP Engine, Python, PHP, Twig, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
PlateaPR
•	Developed and implemented a React and Next.js-based road trip planner, focusing on both design and front-end development.
•	Implemented ETL services to optimize data consumption, improving the efficiency and scalability of data processing.
•	Designed and built a user-friendly directory to enhance search functionality for places within the company's blog.


Bankrate

•	Led the development of  an alternative testing application to isolate testing processes, ensuring a cleaner and more maintainable code base.
•	Created and implemented scripts to update content across the entire website, enhancing usability and improving the overall user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Data Analytics IRAD

•	Packaged software services environments using Singularity and Docker to streamline deployments.
•	Supported the architecture, design, and integration of data analytics systems, including Anomaly Detection, Filtering, Weco Nelson Rules, Association Rules, Correlation, Forecasting/Prediction Modeling, and Classification Models.
•	Discovered correlations between various attributes through association rule mining and correlation analysis.
•	Developed data parsers, web scrapers, and performed extensive data cleansing and feature engineering for data-driven insights.

Command & Control IRAD
•	Implemented a polynomial regression algorithm to predict trends and behaviors within databases.
•	Designed, implemented, and administered database schemas for efficient data storage and retrieval.
•	Developed User Interface screens for legacy systems using C# and WPF.
•	Upgraded a logging service built on C# and .NET Core to communicate via standards-based web services over a commercially available ESB, integrating it with PostgreSQL synchronization.
•	Migrated database schemas using the Django Rest Framework, improving backend system functionality.

projects.title: Peek At Your Power Project
projects.description: The Peek At Your Power Project is born from the Energy Footprint Concept. The project consists in the design and implementation of an electrical outlet tool with an embedded system that monitors power consumption and gives the user control of the system via Wi-Fi with a mobile Android application.

projects.title: Data Science Accelerator
projects.description: Successfully completed the in-house Data Science Accelerator program at Red Ventures. This initiative focused on transitioning experienced analysts into data science roles by teaching skills such as statistical programming, data exploration, visualization, and machine learning. The program included coursework from top universities (via Coursera and edX) and an applied capstone project, where I used natural language processing to build predictive models for real business challenges. Collaborated with mentors from the data science team, gaining hands-on experience and valuable insights into the daily work of a data scientist.
